notes: Marka is an offline written-assessment companion built for Filipino teachers
Organise exams by subject, import your class roster, and scan answer sheets using your school's layout
Marka reviews each sheet, flags doubtful entries, and connects every score to the right student
See results by student or class, identify missing papers, review item analysis, and track mastery of embedded DepEd MELCs
Produce individual, class and school reports, or let Marka fill your own Excel forms
Backup management, restoration guidance and password-protected exports keep a term's work from being trapped on one phone
Nine short video lessons with a voice-over are built in, under Settings → How to use Marka
Settings → App updates keeps Marka current: it checks once a day and tells you quietly when a new version is ready
